values.stringValue: Mid-morning, the party decides not to return to Vivian yet and continues toward the dwarven mine, ignoring the goblins' northbound trail.
The party reaches a clearing with a wrecked, smoking caravan and several bodies, and spots goblins cautiously emerging to loot the dead.
Purist charges and Nail follows; combat breaks out with Pippin drunkenly fighting at a penalty and Victorf mostly hanging back.
After several missed swings, Nail lands a devastating sword blow that hacks a goblin down at the legs, leaving it dying.
The remaining goblin attempts to flee; Purist and Thrillho pursue and Purist crushes its skull with a mace, killing it.
With the goblins dead, the party examines the caravan and notices a strong sulfur stench, corrosion/singed damage, ripped tents, and gruesomely mutilated corpses-signs of a possible dragon attack.
Nail tries to read tracks but can't make out any clear trail.
The party recovers a few coins from the dead and goblins: about 1 gp from the caravan victims and 7 gp from goblin bodies; Pippin retrieves his thrown spear.
Around 5 p.m., the party withdraws from Brol's North Cave and decides to head south/southwest toward town to regroup and seek help (witch/smith).
The party discovers and approaches a vine-covered, partially collapsed stone monastery in the woods.
Nail scouts through a monastery window and spots three goblins inside building a mud goblin effigy; the party hides and regroups outside the windows.
Victorf conducts recon at another window, realizing there are additional goblins in an adjacent room; he signals the others that there are many more than three.
Nail casts Sleep, putting six goblins in the larger room and one goblin in the effigy room into magical slumber for about 40 minutes.
Nail climbs in through a window to engage the two remaining awake goblins by the effigy; they flee screaming for help into the monastery.
Purist and Thrillho join the fight, wounding and then killing fleeing goblins near the effigy room.
Victorf slips into the southern room and begins killing sleeping goblins with a dagger; he also glimpses a larger goblin on a throne (a goblin leader) rousing.
Pippin tumbles through a window, kills a sleeping goblin by the effigy, then gets nicked for 1 damage as more goblins rouse and swarm into the fight.
Combat escalates as additional goblins pour out from the sleeping area toward the party; the session ends mid-fight with the goblin leader looming.
Nail pays for a room at Bentley's tavern in Brandonsford, buys Foxtail Brew, and keeps Thrillho tied to the bed for the night.
The next morning at the tavern, Nail and Thrillho meet new adventurers Chev and Bog and agree to team up to pursue the dragon treasure.
Purist, at 1 HP, is marched back to the monastery by a drunken goblin with a knife at his back; his weapon is taken but his pack remains.
Inside the monastery, Purist bluffs the goblin using the "ghost of Victorf" as leverage, buying time before the goblins plan to tie him up for later interrogation.
Purist bolts through a window and escapes the monastery, leaving Victorf's ghost behind, and makes it back to the tavern late at night.
Purist rests at the tavern but only recovers 1 HP, remaining badly wounded.
Nail tries an ankle-leash on Thrillho; Thrillho cuts the rope with his hand axe and attempts to walk off toward the dryad's tree.
With Chev and Bog, the party heads from Brandonsford to the enchanted tree intending to destroy it and free Thrillho from the dryad's charm.
At the tree, Purist resists the tree's whispering charm and helps build a pyre of forest debris around it.
Thrillho threatens self-harm to stop them, then tries to beat out the flames when Bog lights the pyre; Bog restrains Thrillho while the tree burns.
After hours, the tree dies and Thrillho's charm fades, leaving the party reunited and back at square one.
Around 1:30-2:30 p.m., the party arrives northeast at the dwarven mine and finds the exterior cabin burned down weeks ago and the mine entrance caved in.
The party searches the burned cabin rubble, finding a mining pick engraved with brother Brol's name.
A further search turns up four gems (worth 50 gp each).
Another search finds a mining pick engraved with brother Grelly's name.
The party recovers 14 iron ingots from the wreckage.
Searching continues; Thrillho uncovers a dwarven corpse buried in the cabin debris.
Another search finds another brother's mining pick.
Purist uncovers a second dwarven corpse in the rubble.
Victorf finds a small pouch containing 14 gp.
Nail finds an additional 23 gp while searching.
Two human would-be dragon hunters, Tad and Zack, emerge from the woods claiming they plan to trap the dragon with a net and a dead pig; they then wander off.
The party investigates the mine cave-in, digs through rubble, and discovers another dead dwarf wearing a strange opal ring; Purist takes the ring.

Victorf tries on the ring, summoning the ghost of Grimny, who reveals Brol collapsed the mine out of greed after finding a large pirate treasure cache and likely killed the other brothers; Grimny points to Brol's nearby private cave hideout.
Grimny asks the party to find his bejeweled silver beard comb in the cabin; the party searches and recovers it, and Thrillho agrees to keep it.
Guided by Grimny, the party heads west to Brol's cave ("North Cave"), noticing sulfur smell, rumbling/snoring from within, and yellow smoke at the entrance.

Hearing coins and large shuffling inside, the party decides they are unprepared and flees; Grimny walks into the cave and fades/disappears as he moves out of range while Victorf remains wearing the ring.
The party wakes up at the Clumsy Fox in Brandonsford and sets out northwest, planning to swing west for the wine trees on the way to the mine.
Along the river, the party spots goblins attacking a giant beaver on its lodge; Nail looses an arrow but misses, and the party chooses not to intervene further.
The giant beaver mauls one goblin, driving the others to flee west; one goblin escapes onto the far bank.
Traveling upriver, the party finds a huge fallen tree used as a bridge and crosses to the west side.

In the woods, several goblins with a wheelbarrow of stolen trade goods scatter and hide; Victorf uses ventriloquism to impersonate their king, panicking them into fleeing and abandoning the wheelbarrow.
The party searches the abandoned wheelbarrow, taking rope, wine, 20 arrows, rations, and lamp oil, then dumps the rest rather than hauling it.
The party heads west and finds a deliberate clearing of strange, sweet-smelling trees consistent with the magical wine grove.
The party follows music into the grove and encounters fawns reveling among the wine trees; they negotiate for wine.
Pippin trades away a sentimental rope for a golden goblet of fawn wine.
Pippin drinks a sip of the fawn wine, succeeds a poison save, and becomes instantly and overwhelmingly drunk.
Victorf secures the remaining fawn wine in a waterskin and keeps the golden goblet as the party prepares to continue on.
The survivors flee through the woods through the evening, still on edge after the goblin massacre.
Just as the sun begins to set, Thrillho is charmed by a dryad manifested in a tree and tries to embrace it.
Nail yanks Thrillho away and drags him onward; Purist identifies the creature as a dryad and warns it can be killed by destroying its tree (and that treasure may lie in its roots).
Thrillho remains under the dryad's charm and compulsively wants to return, so the group considers binding/using the bonsai of lashing to restrain him.
The party splits: Purist doubles back alone toward the ruined monastery to retrieve the missing wine while Nail hauls the restrained Thrillho back to town.
At the monastery at night, Purist finds multiple bodies outside and draws out a drunken goblin with a shouted challenge.
Purist fights the goblin, is badly wounded, and is captured and taken inside as the goblin begins tying him up and interrogating him about the drink/wine skin.
Nail and the bound Thrillho arrive back in town and head to the tavern to get a room and clean up.
The party wins a pirate treasure map in high-stakes gambling in Dram, pointing to a spot north of Brandonsford.
In the early evening, the party arrives in Brandonsford and heads into the Clumsy Fox tavern to ask about the map.
At the Clumsy Fox, the proprietors Bentley and Eloise suggest Warwick the blacksmith might know about the map's location near the old dwarves' mine.
Outside, the town reeve Eric warns the area is threatened by a black wyrm (dragon) and offers 1000 gold for its death; the party agrees to help.
Eric directs them to George the woodsman (one-armed hunter) for intel; the party goes to his den.
George recounts his encounter: a ~15-20 ft black, wingless dragon with noxious green breath and seemingly invincible scales; he mentions Vivian the witch in the eastern woods may know more.
George gives Nail a longbow and arrows to aid the party against future threats.
As evening approaches, the party visits Warwick the blacksmith, finding his shop warded with clovers, rabbit's feet, and horseshoes.

Warwick explains the dwarven mine's deliveries stopped due to the dragon; he offers his grandfather's mithril chain shirt as payment if the party brings back metal and checks on the dwarves (notably Grimny).
Warwick also reveals a fairy/hooded phantom has been tormenting him at night, leaving flowers and cursed talismans on his door.
Toward night, the party decides it's too late to start for the dwarven mine and instead heads out to the witch's hut in the woods.
In the darkening woods, the party spots elvish hunters with fae hounds searching for a "golden fox," who quickly move on when the party can't help.
Reaching the witch's clearing, the party finds a lifelike row of human-shaped topiary leading to the hut.
At the pond outside the hut, nixies demand the party throw weapons in as "tribute," and the party refuses while noting a heap of rusty weapons and a fancy gold scabbard among the offerings.
Nail knocks and the party meets Vivian the Witch, who lets them inside after sizing them up.

Vivian warns the dragon's scales are tough and suggests a plan involving magical trees in the western woods that drip potent wine capable of knocking mortals unconscious, though she's unsure it will work on a dragon.
Vivian offers Pippin a vine-plant whose cut branches can lash targets; in return she demands a bottle of wine taken from the magical wine-dripping trees.
The party leaves Vivian's hut and returns to Brandonsford at nighttime, using a lantern for light.
The party rents rooms at the Clumsy Fox for the night and settles in, planning next steps (wine trees, dwarven mine, and the dragon).
Purist loots Pippin's corpse, taking the Tree of Lashing (bonsai) and dropping iron ingots to make room, then flees back toward Nail.
A goblin fumbles an attack on Victorf and injures itself, but another goblin slashes Victorf's leg, dropping him to 1 HP.
A goblin catches Purist and deals 5 damage, badly wounding him as he tries to run.
Nail pours oil to slick the doorway as a choke point and retreats toward the window, calling for Thrillho to ignite it.
Thrillho successfully lights the oil, creating a fire barrier that forces the goblins to route around the other way.
Purist jumps through the burning doorway/window area, risks catching fire, and pats himself out to avoid taking damage.
Victorf climbs out the window and runs east; Nail and Thrillho follow, attempting to escape into the unknown woods-side direction.
The goblin king casts Sleep; Victorf, Nail, and Thrillho fail their saves and collapse unconscious outside, while Purist is out of line-of-effect and stays awake.
Purist slaps Victorf awake; Victorf rouses Nail; Nail rouses Thrillho, restoring the party's ability to act.
The goblin king attempts to Charm Purist, but Purist succeeds on his save and resists.
Victorf charges the goblin king with a dagger strike but misses; Nail decides to run off the map to escape.
Thrillho and Purist also flee off the map, abandoning Victorf still near the goblin king and goblins.
The goblin king strikes Victorf with a greatsword, nearly killing him; moments later, surrounding goblins attack and kill Victorf, severing an arm.
The goblins celebrate and brutalize Victorf's corpse; the goblin king takes Victorf's ring.

Late into the evening, the survivors (Thrillho, Purist, Nail) regroup in the woods; Victorf's ghost manifests because the goblin king dons the ring, allowing Victorf to haunt him while the ring remains worn.
